change: readTableCadValue now reads type-4 values as bounded TV strings through readTableText: legacy versions use the body stream and R2007+ uses the detached string stream. Type 512 remains the separate length-prefixed binary path. Removed the obsolete byte-to-text helper.

generatedControls.ac1021: Standalone TABLECONTENT frame places the typed string before the format/value strings in the detached CP8 string stream and checks the exact typed/display text.
generatedControls.ac1024: Embedded TABLE frame places the typed TV in the detached UTF-16 string stream, checks the exact typed/display text, and preserves the following-tail bit boundary.
generatedControls.preFix: Both generated version routes failed their typed/display-text assertions before the parser change.
